draft.heroMessage: Experience the heart of Colorado living with Bernadette Stech.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Paonia—where small town charm meets the grandeur of the Rockies. I’m Bernadette Stech, here to help you discover your place in the North Fork Valley.
draft.tagline: Your guide to Paonia and the North Fork Valley.
draft.aboutParagraph: Having called Paonia home for many years, I know firsthand the joys and opportunities this mountain valley offers. Whether it’s the vineyards, orchards, or the vibrant local culture, Paonia invites you to experience life at a different pace. If you’re considering a move or second home in the area, I’d love to share my insight and show you just why so many choose to stay.
draft.conciergeLine: Looking for the inside scoop on life in Paonia? I’m always a phone call or email away.
draft.contactLine: Ready to talk? Reach out to me directly at 970-261-5928 or bernadette@paoniarealty.com.
draft.tone: Warm, personal, and welcoming while highlighting local expertise.

sections.title: Welcome!
sections.body: Located on the western slope of the Rocky Mountains in Colorado, Paonia and the North Fork Valley have something for everyone. A population of 1600 in Paonia and another 4000 in the surrounding North Fork Valley, means small town living at it's best. Both town and the surrounding mesa tops have breathtaking views of the West Elk Mountains and the Grand Mesa . Nearby is the Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park .

items.title: 41723 O Road, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: A true sanctuary, this property was designed with such exquisite care and attention to detail that to recreate it in the current economy would far exceed the asking price. This rare opportunity to own a mature, food producing estate in the greenbelt of Western Colorado is a once in a lifetime opportunity. Designed with efficiency and wellbeing in mind, an enormous amount of details have been considered towards elevating the homeowner's daily experience; a harmony of elements including non-toxic finishes, unique water structuring systems, passive solar design and so much more. Masterfully built with adobe bricks, lime plaster and stucco, some of the design elements such as reclaimed barn wood features are irreplaceable and create a timeless effect. Coveted Senior Decree water rights, mature shade trees, fruit trees, grape vines, ponds, a main residence and separate barn apartment only begin to list what this estate has to offer. An elaborate patio for entertaining is surrounded by perrennial flowers and shrubs nestled up to the mosaic tiled pizza oven, framed beautifully by Mt. Lamborn. A full horse setup is ready to go, once used for prized mules, the setup includes a hay barn, stockyards and fully fenced paddocks. In the year-round greenhouse grows a mature fruiting fig tree with room to grow; adjacent is a beautifully shaded dog run and nearby fully fenced biodynamic vegetable garden. This is a homestead of elevated proportions, carefully laid out by the owners who are lifelong ranchers and artists. No details were spared in creating this legacy property; an opportunity to experience true land stewardship at the base of the West Elk Mountains. This property is Co-listed with Leslie Newbury of Coldwell Bankers Mason Morse

items.title: 41675 O Road, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: This exceptional property on the idyllic "O" Road near downtown Paonia presents an exciting real estate opportunity. The stand out features include prime acreage, senior water rights, two domestic water taps, fenced pasture as well as mature fruit and shade trees. A beautifully constructed studio and multi-use barn allows you to live and enjoy while envisioning your dream build or family compound. With two domestic water taps, ample irrigation and pasture this property has an unspoken charm that's hard to come by.

items.title: 128 Colorado Avenue, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: Tucked away in the “Heart of Paonia,” this lovely “Paonia Original” is a birders paradise and offers privacy, convenience, and undeniable charm. The property includes two fully furnished residences, complete with furniture, artwork, housewares, and silverware, making it truly move-in or rental ready. Laura’s Tower, built in 2018, is a 993-square-foot retreat perched above Rio Grande Avenue, offering bird’s-eye views of the surrounding area. This two-story residence features a covered north-facing deck overlooking the mesas and a sunny south-facing balcony above Stewart Ditch. Upstairs, you’ll find a spacious bedroom, office, sitting area, and beautifully tiled full bath. The lower level includes a bright and efficient kitchen, dining area, cozy sitting space, half bath, and stackable washer/dryer combo. Kale’s Cottage, a 374-square-foot Solargon built in 2010, boasts an elegant design and is nestled in its own private oasis setting. Inside, the modern yet cozy interior features a lovely tongue-and-groove vaulted wood ceiling, full kitchen, beautiful Lopi 1250 wood stove, king sized bed, loveseat, work table, and walk-in tiled shower. Step outside to enjoy the covered decks, expansive green lawn, roomy dog kennel, and yard game area. Additional amenities include a separate laundry building with one washer, two dryers, folding table, and extra storage, plus a charming one-room studio with vaulted ceilings and its own dog run. A storage shed provides even more space for tools and miscellaneous items. When you're ready to socialize, you'll have plenty of choices with the vibrant community that Paonia has to offer. There is so much entertainment, with all the arts and musical events, not to mention Paonia's lush Town Park where Paonians meet for Farmers Markets, Festivals, and much more, and just minutes from the Jumbo Mountain trails! Paonia is home to the West Elk AVA, known for some of the finest, award winning Colorado grown high alpine wines! For the outdoor folks, the West Elk Mountains and the Grand Mesa are calling... The current owner has successfully operated the property as a short-term rental for the past 11 years and has earned Airbnb Superhost status. The property ranks in the top 1% of homes on Airbnb based on ratings, reviews, and reliability. Come experience this unique Paonia property and let your imagination run free!

items.title: 42224 Foothills Road, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: Spectacular views of the West Elk Mountains surround this lovingly cared-for home. This charming property features 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and a 1.5-car garage, with an interior that is truly a must-see. Step inside and you will immediately feel a sense of comfort and retreat. Light, bright, and open, the home offers radiant floor heat, a gas stove and fireplace for warmth, and an evaporative cooler for the summer months. A delightful sunroom adds even more views and ambiance to the living space. The jetted soaking tub enhances the spa-like ambiance of the home. The beautifully remodeled kitchen features new cabinetry, updated appliances, tile flooring, and soapstone countertops. Even washing dishes becomes a pleasure while taking in the stunning mountain views. Situated on one acre, the property includes a large fenced yard, mature trees, and a spacious greenhouse. The garage comfortably fits one vehicle while still offering ample storage space. Above the garage, a separate living area provides an inviting retreat with warm-toned walls, wood floors, carpeting, and beautiful built-in bookshelves. Outdoor living is just as inviting, with a sunny patio off the kitchen and a covered porch complete with a ceiling fan for relaxing in the shade.

items.title: 938 Ryan Court, Hotchkiss, Colorado CO 81419
items.description: **Assumable loan may be possible at 2.25% interest rate with an approximate balance of $153,000, subject to lender approval and buyer qualification. Contact agent for details. Beautifully maintained French country-style home set on Barrow Mesa at the edge of town, offering scenic views of the West Elk Mountains. This spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence with a 2 car garage combines charm, comfort, and functionality in a peaceful setting with room to grow. Inside, the home features warm hardwood floors, high ceilings, and abundant natural light, creating an inviting and airy atmosphere throughout. The thoughtfully designed layout includes an eat-in kitchen, dedicated office space, and a convenient laundry room with washer and dryer included. Radiant floor heat ensures colder weather comfort. The primary suite is a true retreat, complete with a soaking tub, gas fireplace, and walk-in closet. Upstairs, the expansive bedroom over the garage offers incredible flexibility for a variety of uses—guest space, studio, or recreation room. Situated on .83 acres the outdoor living is just as impressive. The property features a fenced backyard and a separately fenced garden area with mature fruit trees, including apricots, Gala, Honeycrisp, and Golden Delicious apples, an Asian pear, grapes, as well as, a glorious array of perennials. A 10x16 shed with lofted storage provides ample space for tools and equipment. Irrigation water is delivered through an underground sprinkler system servicing both front and back yards. The garden area is watered separately with irrigation water. Enjoy the stunning surroundings from the deck with panoramic views in every direction, or relax beneath the pergola for shaded outdoor comfort. With plenty of room for additional outdoor pursuits, this property offers both beauty and potential. A Master Guard home protection system, specifically designed for the house, is also included. Lovingly cared for and move-in ready, this exceptional property is ready to welcome you home.

items.title: 1200 3rd Street, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: One of Paonia’s most distinctive green homes, thoughtfully designed for sustainable, low-cost living, is available now. High ceilings, featuring contemporary ceiling fans, windows on every side and a clerestory provide natural light and airflow throughout so that the home feels much larger than its efficient 1,005 square feet. The open living area is bright and inviting, with radiant heated floors, floating hardwood bamboo flooring, ceramic tile bath, pine ceilings, solid-wood doors, and designer lighting, including newer dimmable canister lights and dark-sky exterior fixtures. In addition, the finishes include gorgeous kitchen cabinetry, low-emittance EverClear windows with insulating premium Hunter Douglas blinds, and stainless steel top-of-the-line Bosch appliances. A large private patio with beautiful flagstone, custom professional landscaping, and flowering and fruit trees creates a lovely, private outdoor living space. Mountain views add to the magic of this home in a dark-sky town. Built in 2018, this 2-bed, 1.5-bath home boasts a metal roof and gutters, state-of-the-art high-insulation 18” thick pumice-crete walls and passive-solar orientation which maintain a remarkably comfortable interior year-round. A community solar array, the largest private photovoltaic bank in the county, provides energy-efficient power to the home and its radiant in-floor heat which means low energy costs for you. It also powers a Level 2 EV charge station. The full-size LG washer and dryer, walk-in shower, powder room, and large pantry create ease for everyday living and entertaining. The home has an attached carport with access from quiet Vista Drive, and a secure storage closet, guest parking, and exclusive use of an additional covered parking space. Some photos of this listing may include virtually staged amenities One of just 11 homes located in a well-maintained, self-managed and friendly neighborhood HOA (2026 dues are only $115!), the home is suitable for full-time or lock-and-leave living for those who like to travel. Pets welcome! The home is less than a mile from creative downtown Paonia and its farm-to-table restaurants, farmers market, and arts scene. A rare combination of beautiful design, exceptionally low utility costs, and both privacy and great neighbors. Enjoy the nature and bounty of the North Fork Valley, known for its organic farms, vineyards, and outdoor recreation, only an hour to Montrose and Grand Junction airports, several excellent hot springs, and a short drive through pristine wilderness in every direction. You are invited to come experience the simple elegance of this home! Some of the photos of this listing may include virtually staged amenities, furniture or fixtures.

items.title: 516 4th Street, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: This ONE-OF-A-KIND HOME is truly a Paonia Jewel! It sits directly across from Paonia Town Park on a huge corner lot. This log home has 3-bedrooms, 2 baths is about 2,000 square feet. Including a large family room that could become a space for a home business, or use for additional bedrooms or even an ADU. Patio doors from the family room open to a beautiful "Rose" lined driveway across from the park. Mature gardens full of perennials and flowers surround the home. Including mature fruit trees and grapes. This home boasts; • Open floor plan • Enclosed wrap around front porch • Carport • Wood floors • Renovated bathrooms • Perennial lover’s dream gardens • Corner lot 8800+ • Some of the tallest trees in town • Grape Arbor, Apple and Pear trees • Driveway 96’x23” • Large Deck • Flagstone Patio on Park Side • Garden Shed • Large Out Building • Alley Access • Home has 4 Fireplaces • Partly Furnished - excluding personal items • All Appliances, New Gas Stove • Easy Access to Downtown. When you're ready to socialize, you'll have plenty of choices within the vibrant community that Paonia has to offer. There is so much entertainment, from arts and musical events to Paonia Town Park, where locals gather for weekly farmers markets, festivals, and much more. Plus, you’ll be just minutes from the Jumbo Mountain Trails. The North Fork Valley is home to the West Elk AVA, known for some of the finest award-winning, Colorado-grown high-alpine wines. For outdoor enthusiasts, the West Elk Mountains and the Grand Mesa are calling. Make an appointment today to view this lovely property!

items.title: 480 Hawthorn Drive, Hotchkiss, Colorado CO 81419
items.description: Discover this light, bright, starlit home built in 2020 on an exceptional cul-de-sac lot in the coveted North Ridge Meadows neighborhood, where fantastic views stretch in every direction. Situated on 0.6 acres, the property offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a spacious 2-car garage. The recently added front landscaping enhances the home's curb appeal and creates a beautiful setting for relaxing on the covered front porch. Inside, the light-filled open floor plan features soaring ceilings, sleek concrete floors, and radiant heat. The contemporary kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and designed for both style and function. There is a whole house water purification system included with the property. Wake up to stunning views from the primary suite, complete with an inviting soaking tub. Throughout the home, expansive windows frame the lush valley, pastoral countryside, and mountain vistas beyond bringing in abundant natural light. Everything you have is here and allows you to live into the natural world. The generous side and back yards provide ample space for a large garden, orchard, or your own creative landscaping vision. Others in the neighborhood have added studios and other outbuildings with subdivision approval. Experience this special property perched above the charming town of Hotchkiss.

items.title: 234 Delta Avenue, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: Welcome home to the vibrant town of Paonia, where tree-lined streets, small-town charm and abundant recreation, organic food and creative arts surround this inviting, freshly painted and beautifully updated home. Inside, warm wood floors, generous built-in cabinetry and a rock-accented chimney add character, while thoughtful improvements include solar panels, efficient cold climate heat pump, new plumbing, well-insulated attic, double pane, low-e windows, updated electrical and high-speed Elevate internet. The bright eat-in kitchen features a skylight, new stainless steel refrigerator, an induction range and plenty of cabinetry. Retreat to the private primary suite with vaulted ceilings, its own bathroom and a spacious walk-in closet. A second bedroom plus a dedicated office provide comfortable, flexible living space. The basement offers additional potential and ample storage—and be sure to ask about the secret storage on the main level! Outside, the professionally xeriscaped front yard features a creative dry creek bed and organic landscape for low-maintenance curb appeal. Out back, enjoy a shady, privacy-fenced yard. Convenient off-street parking in the alley or a few steps from the front door accommodates EVs or conventional vehicles. Enjoy year-round comfort and utility savings with the LG RED cold climate heat pump and grid-tied solar power for comfortable indoor temperatures whether it is summer or winter. With its combination of character, energy-, money and water-saving upgrades, storage, flexible space and a welcoming in-town setting, this Paonia home offers an easygoing Western Colorado lifestyle just waiting to be enjoyed.

items.title: 100 Rio Grande Avenue, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: Welcome home to your own personal Oasis! Located just 8 blocks from Downtown Paonia and just 3 blocks from Paonia Town Park. This home and property has the perfect combination of privacy and convenience! Enjoy your covered and protected patio area on the north side of the home, during the warmer days of summer. There is plenty of irrigation water to keep the numerous fruit trees growing on your .36 acre lot, with plenty of water left for your vegetables and flowers, keeping everything green! This spacious home has 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, with a large inviting eat-in kitchen, an ample dining room, and extensive living room. You'll enjoy the warm and lovely Saltillo tile throughout the entry, kitchen, hallway and bathroom. The dining room features hardwood flooring. When you're ready to socialize, you'll have plenty of choices with the vibrant community that Paonia has to offer. There is so much entertainment, with all the arts and musical events, not to mention Paonia's lush Town Park where Paonians meet for Farmers Markets, Festivals, and much more, and just minutes from the Jumbo Mountain trails! Paonia is home to the West Elk AVA, known for some of the finest, award winning Colorado grown high alpine wines! For the outdoor folks, the West Elk Mountains are calling... This lovely well maintained home and property has had many improvements and updates over the years, it's a must see! Make an appointment to view this home today!

items.title: 208 W Main Street, Hotchkiss, Colorado CO 81419
items.description: This charming 1902 Farmhouse, located on a quiet street in the "Heart of Hotchkiss" is full of classic details from yesteryear. There is beautiful hand made original woodwork and trim throughout the home, from the curved archways into the dining room to the bay seated windows in the living room and primary bedroom. A lovely mantle adorns the fireplace and the three pane vintage front door says "Welcome"! Enjoy the front porch as you take in the mountain air and the hand sculpted rock work. The large bright farm kitchen is inviting and has plenty of storage. The upstairs bedrooms feature the original turn of the century bead-board throughout, echoing a time long past. The primary bedroom and the larger upstairs bedroom have both been recently been painted, as well as the east entry room and the dining room. Under the wood siding, the original exterior walls of the home are made of hand hewn logs, which add natural insulative value. There is a carport to keep your car free of snow and rain, an outdoor shed for lawn and gardening tools etc...and a lovely garden spot! This home is located just minutes from downtown Hotchkiss, with wonderful restaurants, the post office, the City Market, the Yoga Tree Studio and many other necessary businesses. The North Fork Valley is home to the West Elk AVA, known for some of the finest, award winning Colorado grown high alpine wines! For the outdoor folks, the West Elk Mountains and the Grand Mesa are beckoning! Make an appointment to see this home today, they don't make them like this anymore!

items.title: 38153 Coburn Road, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: River Springs Ranch is set on 72 riverfront acres with Abundant Water The property located on the North Fork of the Gunnison River is a rare offering defined by abundant water, exceptional privacy, and captivating views. Comprised of two legal parcels with the ability to build up to four residences, the property includes one domestic water tap, with the opportunity to utilize one of the natural springs as a domestic water source for additional homes (please see attached documents for details). Water is one of the ranch's greatest assets. Nine natural springs are decreed to provide 0.5 cfs, complemented by 16.5 shares of Paonia Ditch water—one of the North Fork Valley's oldest and most reliable irrigation systems, traditionally delivering water into October. With over a half a mile of river frontage, this property flourishes. Adding to the land’s allure, Short Ditch runs through the property. Positioned at the end of quiet Coburn Road, the ranch enjoys sweeping views of the Grand Mesa, the West Elk Mountains, the North Fork of the Gunnison River, and the surrounding countryside. Soak in this peaceful setting or venture 3 miles to the vibrant town of Paonia, offering a renowned blend of agriculture, art, local food, wineries, and outdoor recreation. Historically used for cattle grazing, the property currently benefits from favorable agricultural tax status while offering tremendous potential for alternative agricultural ventures, including specialty crops or livestock, orchard, vineyard, or regenerative farming. The property produces a bountiful wild asparagus crop each year. The ranch's wetlands, cottonwood forests, river frontage, and abundant water create an exceptional wildlife habitat. Elk, mule deer, black bear, bald eagles, hawks, cranes, waterfowl, and countless other species frequent the property, making it an extraordinary setting for nature lovers, conservation-minded owners, or wildlife rehabilitation opportunities. The elk herd has overwintered in the area and has numbered in the 100s. Additionally, Elevate high-speed fiber optic internet is available. Whether envisioned as a private legacy ranch, family compound, conservation property, agricultural enterprise, or water-rich retreat, River Springs Ranch presents a truly unique opportunity in Colorado's North Fork Valley. Located next to a 410 acre conservation easement, the property's exceptional natural resources make it an outstanding candidate for a conservation easement. **Irrigated acreage was estimated by aerial map. Appointment necessary as road easement crosses private land.

items.title: 38153 Coburn Road, Paonia, Colorado CO 81428
items.description: River Springs Ranch is set on 72 riverfront acres with Abundant Water The property located on the North Fork of the Gunnison River is a rare offering defined by abundant water, exceptional privacy, and captivating views. Comprised of two legal parcels with the ability to build up to four residences, the property includes one domestic water tap, with the opportunity to utilize one of the natural springs as a domestic water source for additional homes (please see attached documents for details). Water is one of the ranch's greatest assets. Nine natural springs are decreed to provide 0.5 cfs, complemented by 16.5 shares of Paonia Ditch water—one of the North Fork Valley's oldest and most reliable irrigation systems, traditionally delivering water into October. With over a half a mile of river frontage, this property flourishes. Adding to the land’s allure, Short Ditch runs through the property. Positioned at the end of quiet Coburn Road, the ranch enjoys sweeping views of the Grand Mesa, the West Elk Mountains, the North Fork of the Gunnison River, and the surrounding countryside. Soak in this peaceful setting or venture 3 miles to the vibrant town of Paonia, offering a renowned blend of agriculture, art, local food, wineries, and outdoor recreation. Historically used for cattle grazing, the property currently benefits from favorable agricultural tax status while offering tremendous potential for alternative agricultural ventures, including specialty crops or livestock, orchard, vineyard, or regenerative farming. The property produces a bountiful wild asparagus crop each year. The ranch's wetlands, cottonwood forests, river frontage, and abundant water create an exceptional wildlife habitat. Elk, mule deer, black bear, bald eagles, hawks, cranes, waterfowl, and countless other species frequent the property, making it an extraordinary setting for nature lovers, conservation-minded owners, or wildlife rehabilitation opportunities. The elk herd has overwintered in the area and has numbered in the 100s. Additionally, Elevate high-speed fiber optic internet is available. Whether envisioned as a private legacy ranch, family compound, conservation property, agricultural enterprise, or water-rich retreat, River Springs Ranch presents a truly unique opportunity in Colorado's North Fork Valley. Located next to a 410 acre conservation easement, the property's exceptional natural resources make it an outstanding candidate for a conservation easement. **Irrigated acreage was estimated by aerial map. Appointment necessary as road easement crosses private land.

sections.title: North Idaho’s Silver Valley
sections.body: Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.
